$comment: How long a drawing wears its New badge. Source, not generated: no build step writes this file. The badge is measured in DAYS SINCE THE DRAWING WAS ADDED and has nothing to do with releases — tying it to a version meant a release cleared the badges of the drawings it was announcing, and a set that ships twice in a week would show a badge for about a day. `clearedBefore` is the manual override: set it to a timestamp to drop every badge earned before then. ONLY Zafar changes these values, stated explicitly, every time. Cutting a release must never touch either of them. `clearedExcept` names drawings the floor skips, still bound by `newForDays`: first drawn on a branch before the floor and shipped after it (car and rocket, first committed 4 and 9 Sep 2026, shipped in 1.0.0; his call, 22 Sep 2026). `newForDays` was 30 until 27 Sep 2026, when he set it to 14.
